Amazon OpenSearch Serverless supports Neural Search functionality for semantic search
operations on your data. Neural Search uses machine learning models to understand the semantic
meaning and context of your queries, providing more relevant search results than traditional
keyword-based searches. This section explains how to conﬁgure Neural Search in OpenSearch
Serverless, including the required permissions, supported processors, and key diﬀerences from the
standard OpenSearch implementation.
With Neural Search you can perform semantic search on your data, which considers semantic
meaning to understand the intent of your search queries. This capability is powered by the
following components:
• Text embedding ingest pipeline processor
• Neural query
• Neural sparse query
